title: Treasury Do Not Pay — Governmentwide Structural Map
question: What does Treasury Do Not Pay screen, how far does it reach, and who owns the actual eligibility or adverse-action decision?
bluf: Do Not Pay is a governmentwide shared screening network, not a conclusive blacklist: Treasury operates the Working System, controlled data access and a federal payment checkpoint, while each federal or State-administered program must verify a match and apply its own eligibility, notice, contest and recovery authority.
entities: Treasury Bureau of the Fiscal Service
Department of Health and Human Services
